        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM workday__employee_overview e 
        INNER JOIN workday__job_overview j ON j.compensation_grade_id = e.compensation_grade_id 
        INNER JOIN workday__organization_overview o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id;
        """
        
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(count_query)
        row_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        print(f"Total joined rows: {row_count}")
        
        if row_count > 0:
            # Execute the main query
            cursor.execute(query)
            
            # Get column names
